name: @kitora/flow
description: Kitora's node and flow editor: a framework-free graph core (ports, edges, viewport, layered auto-layout, connection rules, undo history, clipboard, JSON) with a React canvas on the dnd kit's activation and interactive-press rules and the keyboard kit's keymap (pan, zoom, pinch, drag, marquee, connect, snap and guides, keyboard) and styled minimap, controls and node cards.

exports.name: XY
exports.description: A point or vector in flow (world) coordinates unless a name says `screen`.

exports.name: Rect
exports.description: An axis-aligned box; `x`/`y` is the top-left corner.

exports.name: PORT_SIDES
exports.description: Which side of its node a port sits on; also the direction an edge leaves or enters it.

exports.name: PortSide
exports.description: One of `PORT_SIDES`.

exports.name: PORT_KINDS
exports.description: `out` ports start edges, `in` ports end them; an edge always runs out → in.

exports.name: PortKind
exports.description: One of `PORT_KINDS`.

exports.name: FlowPort
exports.description: A connection point on a node.

exports.name: FlowNode
exports.description: A box on the canvas. `type` picks the renderer; `data` is the host's payload.

exports.name: EDGE_KINDS
exports.description: How an edge is drawn.

exports.name: EdgeKind
exports.description: One of `EDGE_KINDS`.

exports.name: FlowEdge
exports.description: A directed connection from one node's out port to another node's in port.

exports.name: Graph
exports.description: The persisted part of a flow: what undo, redo, copy and save operate on.

exports.name: Viewport
exports.description: Pan and zoom: screen = flow × zoom + (x, y).

exports.name: Selection
exports.description: The ids of the selected nodes and edges.

exports.name: EMPTY_SELECTION
exports.description: A selection with nothing in it.

exports.name: SizeMap
exports.description: Measured node sizes by id; kept outside history because they follow the DOM, not the user.

exports.name: DEFAULT_NODE_SIZE
exports.description: Size a node gets before it is measured, so layout and edges have something to work with.

exports.name: FlowState
exports.description: Everything the editor holds. `past`/`future` are graph snapshots for undo and redo.

props.name: graph
props.description: The current nodes and edges.

props.name: selection
props.description: What is selected now.

props.name: viewport
props.description: The current pan and zoom.

props.name: sizes
props.description: Measured node sizes; not part of history.

props.name: past
props.description: Earlier graphs, oldest first, for undo.

props.name: future
props.description: Undone graphs, for redo; cleared by any new change.

exports.name: HISTORY_LIMIT
exports.description: How many undo steps are kept; older ones are dropped first.

exports.name: nodeRect
exports.description: The node's box in flow coordinates: fixed size, else measured, else the default.

exports.name: portSide
exports.description: The side a port sits on: its own `side`, else `left` for inputs and `right` for outputs.

exports.name: portOffset
exports.description: Position of a port along its side, 0..1: its own `offset`, else spread evenly among the side's ports.

exports.name: portPoint
exports.description: Where an edge meets a port, in flow coordinates.
exports.signature: (node: FlowNode<unknown>, port: FlowPort, sizes: SizeMap) => XY

exports.name: sideVector
exports.description: Unit vector pointing away from the node on a side.

exports.name: center
exports.description: The centre point of a rect.

exports.name: rectsIntersect
exports.description: Whether two rects overlap; rects that only touch do not.

exports.name: rectFromPoints
exports.description: Normalises a drag from `a` to `b` (any direction) into a rect.

exports.name: boundsOf
exports.description: Smallest rect holding every input rect, or undefined for none.

exports.name: edgePath
exports.description: The SVG path of an edge from `s` leaving through `sSide` to `t` entering through `tSide`.
exports.signature: (kind: EdgeKind, s: XY, sSide: PortSide, t: XY, tSide: PortSide) => EdgePath

exports.name: stepPoints
exports.description: Orthogonal route: a stub out of each port, then one or two elbows between the stubs.
exports.signature: (s: XY, sSide: PortSide, t: XY, tSide: PortSide) => XY[]

exports.name: EdgePath
exports.description: A drawable edge: the SVG path plus the point a label sits on.

exports.name: clampZoom
exports.description: Clamps `zoom` into `limits`.

exports.name: screenToFlow
exports.description: Converts a screen point (relative to the pane) to flow coordinates.

exports.name: flowToScreen
exports.description: Converts a flow point to screen coordinates relative to the pane.

exports.name: zoomAt
exports.description: Zooms to `zoom` keeping the flow point under the screen point `anchor` fixed (cursor-anchored zoom).
exports.signature: (v: Viewport, zoom: number, anchor: XY, limits?: ZoomLimits) => Viewport

exports.name: fitBounds
exports.description: The viewport that shows `bounds` centred in a `width × height` screen, never past `maxZoom`.
exports.signature: (bounds: Rect, width: number, height: number, limits?: ZoomLimits, padding?: number) => Viewport

exports.name: visibleRect
exports.description: The flow-space rect a `width × height` screen currently shows.
exports.signature: (v: Viewport, width: number, height: number) => Rect

exports.name: centerOn
exports.description: Pans so the flow point `p` sits at the centre of the screen.
exports.signature: (v: Viewport, p: XY, width: number, height: number) => Viewport

exports.name: MIN_ZOOM
exports.description: Zoom limits; the canvas props can narrow them.

exports.name: MAX_ZOOM
exports.description: Largest zoom the canvas allows by default.

exports.name: ZOOM_STEP
exports.description: One zoom-in / zoom-out step (buttons and +/- keys).

exports.name: FIT_PADDING
exports.description: Empty screen space fit view leaves around the graph, in pixels.

exports.name: ZoomLimits
exports.description: The smallest and largest zoom a viewport may reach.

exports.name: DEFAULT_ZOOM_LIMITS
exports.description: Zoom limits from `MIN_ZOOM` and `MAX_ZOOM`.

exports.name: snapToGrid
exports.description: Rounds a point to the nearest multiple of `grid`; returns it unchanged when `grid` is 0 or less.

exports.name: alignGuides
exports.description:
Pulls `moving` onto the nearest edge or centre of any `other` box within `threshold`
(flow units), independently on each axis, and reports the guide lines to draw.
exports.signature: (moving: Rect, others: readonly Rect[], threshold: number) => AlignResult

exports.name: Guide
exports.description: One guide line to draw: vertical lines have an `x`, horizontal ones a `y`; `from`/`to` span the aligned boxes.

exports.name: AlignResult
exports.description: Where alignment guides pull a dragged rect, and the guide lines to draw.

exports.name: rankNodes
exports.description: Rank of every node: 0 for sources, else one more than its deepest predecessor; cycles are broken first.
exports.signature: (nodeIds: readonly string[], edges: readonly { readonly source: string; readonly target: string; }[]) => Map<string, number>

exports.name: layoutGraph
exports.description: Positions for every node of `graph`; nodes keep their ids and data, only `position` changes.
exports.signature: <D>(graph: Graph<D>, sizes: SizeMap, options?: LayoutOptions) => Graph<D>

exports.name: LAYOUT_DIRECTIONS
exports.description: Auto-layout directions: `LR` places ranks as columns left to right, `TB` as rows top to bottom.

exports.name: LayoutDirection
exports.description: One of `LAYOUT_DIRECTIONS`.

exports.name: LayoutOptions
exports.description: Options of `layoutGraph`; each one left out takes the built-in default.

exports.name: LayoutEngine
exports.description:
The auto-layout seam: any function that returns the graph with new node positions.
`layoutGraph` is the default; a host can plug dagre, ELK, a force layout or its own.

exports.name: nearestNode
exports.description: The id of the nearest node from `fromId` in `direction`, or undefined when none lies that way; the first node when `fromId` is not found.
exports.signature: (fromId: string, direction: NavDirection, nodes: readonly FlowNode<unknown>[], sizes: SizeMap) => string | undefined

exports.name: NAV_DIRECTIONS
exports.description: Directions the arrow keys move focus between nodes.

exports.name: NavDirection
exports.description: One of `NAV_DIRECTIONS`.

exports.name: findPort
exports.description: The port with id `portId` on `node`, or undefined when the node or port does not exist.
exports.signature: (node: FlowNode<unknown> | undefined, portId: string) => FlowPort | undefined

exports.name: orient
exports.description: Orders a drag that may have started on either end into out → in; undefined when both ends are the same kind.
exports.signature: (a: PortRef, b: PortRef, graph: Graph<unknown>) => { source: PortRef; target: PortRef; } | undefined

exports.name: canConnect
exports.description: Checks the built-in rules (existence, lock, self loop, direction, duplicate, data type, capacity), then `validate`; returns `ok` or why the edge is refused.
exports.signature: <D>(source: PortRef, target: PortRef, graph: Graph<D>, validate?: ConnectValidator<D>) => ConnectReason

exports.name: edgeId
exports.description: The id a new edge between two ports gets; unique against `taken`.
exports.signature: (source: PortRef, target: PortRef, taken: ReadonlySet<string>) => string

exports.name: makeEdge
exports.description: The edge from `source` to `target`, with an id unique against `taken` and the `kind` when given.
exports.signature: (source: PortRef, target: PortRef, taken: ReadonlySet<string>, kind?: EdgeKind) => FlowEdge

exports.name: uniqueId
exports.description: `base` if free, else `base-2`, `base-3`, …

exports.name: PortRef
exports.description: One side of a prospective edge.

exports.name: CONNECT_REASONS
exports.description: Why a connection was refused; `ok` when it was not.

exports.name: ConnectReason
exports.description: One of `CONNECT_REASONS`: `ok`, or the rule that refused a connection.

exports.name: ConnectValidator
exports.description: A host rule run after the built-in ones; return false to refuse the connection (reported as `custom`).

exports.name: copySelection
exports.description: The selected nodes and only the edges with both ends among them, as a graph to keep as the clipboard.

exports.name: prepareClip
exports.description: The clip with fresh ids (unique against `into`), shifted by `offset`; the result is ready to append.
exports.signature: <D>(clip: Graph<D>, into: Graph<D>, offset: number) => Graph<D>

exports.name: memoryClipboard
exports.description: The default clipboard: one clip held in memory, private to whoever created it.

exports.name: PASTE_OFFSET
exports.description: How far each paste is offset from the copied position, in flow units.

exports.name: FlowClipboard
exports.description:
Where copied nodes go and where paste reads them from: the clipboard seam.
The default keeps the clip in memory per controller; swap it to share one clip
between several canvases, persist it, or mirror it to the system clipboard.

exports.name: toDocument
exports.description: Wraps a graph and an optional viewport in a versioned document.

exports.name: stringifyFlow
exports.description: The graph and optional viewport as a pretty-printed JSON document.

exports.name: parseFlow
exports.description: Parses and validates a JSON document; `parseData` checks each node's `data`. Returns the document or the first problem with its JSON path.

exports.name: parseFlowValue
exports.description: Validates an already-parsed value as a flow document, the same way `parseFlow` does.

exports.name: FLOW_DOC_VERSION
exports.description: Current document version; bump it and add a migration when the shape changes.

exports.name: FlowDocument
exports.description: A saved flow: the versioned JSON shape `stringifyFlow` writes and `parseFlow` reads.

exports.name: ParseResult
exports.description: Result of a load: the document, or the first problem found with its JSON path.

exports.name: DataParser
exports.description: Turns a node's raw `data` into the host's type; return undefined to reject the node.

exports.name: createFlowState
exports.description: A fresh editor state for `graph`: nothing selected, no sizes, empty history.

exports.name: removeFromGraph
exports.description: Removes nodes and edges, plus every edge touching a removed node. Locked nodes stay.
exports.signature: <D>(graph: Graph<D>, nodeIds: readonly string[], edgeIds: readonly string[]) => Graph<D>

exports.name: flowReducer
exports.description: The editor reducer: applies one action and returns the next state, recording graph changes for undo.

exports.name: SELECT_MODES
exports.description: How a select action combines with the current selection: replace it, add to it, or toggle each id.

exports.name: SelectMode
exports.description: One of `SELECT_MODES`.

exports.name: FlowAction
exports.description: Every change the editor can make, one per user action; pass it to `flowReducer`.

exports.name: rebindFlowKeys
exports.description: The bindings with some commands rebound: every default binding of a listed command is replaced by the given keys.
exports.signature: (overrides: Readonly<Partial<Record<FlowCommand, readonly string[]>>>, base?: readonly FlowKeyBinding[]) => FlowKeyBinding[]

exports.name: FLOW_COMMANDS
exports.description: Every command the canvas key map can run.

exports.name: FlowCommand
exports.description: One of `FLOW_COMMANDS`.

exports.name: FlowKeyBinding
exports.description:
One key binding of the canvas, as data: a binding string in the keyboard
kit's grammar (`Mod+z`, `Alt+ArrowLeft`, `Plus`; `Mod` is ⌘ on Apple
platforms and Ctrl elsewhere) and the command it runs. `shift` marks the
Shift variant of a command whose behaviour Shift changes (nudge ×5, add to
the selection). The React canvas registers these as keyboard-kit commands
scoped to the focused canvas, so a host's keymap editor, cheatsheet and
conflict checks see them.

exports.name: FLOW_KEY_BINDINGS
exports.description: The key-map seam's default: arrows move focus, Alt+arrows move the selection, the usual editing chords. Pass your own list to rebind.

exports.name: FLOW_KEY_HELP
exports.description: The default bindings for a help panel, in display order.

exports.name: FlowMessages
exports.description: Every message the canvas announces in its live region; pass a partial override to translate or rephrase them.

exports.name: DEFAULT_FLOW_MESSAGES
exports.description: The default English wording.

exports.name: FLOW_ATTR
exports.description: The data attribute names the canvas parts write and the pointer engine reads; mark custom parts with them.

exports.name: flowHit
exports.description: Classifies an event target; anything outside a node, port, edge or overlay is the pane.

exports.name: nodeIdAt
exports.description: The node id of the closest node wrapper around a target, if any.

exports.name: FlowHit
exports.description: What a pointer press landed on: overlay UI, a port, a node (and whether on a control inside it), an edge, or the empty pane.

exports.name: localPoint
exports.description: A client point relative to an element's top-left.
exports.signature: (el: Element | null, e: { readonly clientX: number; readonly clientY: number; }) => XY

exports.name: wheelIntent
exports.description: Reads one wheel event; `at` is the cursor relative to the pane. Shift+wheel pans sideways.
exports.signature: (e: WheelLike, at: XY, mode?: WheelMode) => WheelIntent

exports.name: WHEEL_MODES
exports.description: What a plain wheel does on the canvas: pan, or zoom at the cursor.

exports.name: WheelMode
exports.description: One of `WHEEL_MODES`.

exports.name: WHEEL_ZOOM_K
exports.description: Wheel delta to zoom factor: zoom × exp(-delta × k).

exports.name: PINCH_ZOOM_K
exports.description: The same for a trackpad pinch, whose deltas are much smaller.

exports.name: WheelIntent
exports.description: What one wheel event asks for: zoom by `factor` at a point, or pan by a delta.

exports.name: WheelLike
exports.description: The fields of a wheel event `wheelIntent` reads.

exports.name: createSizeObserver
exports.description: Calls `onSizes` with the nodes whose measured size differs from `known()`.
exports.signature: (known: () => SizeMap, onSizes: (sizes: Record<string, { width: number; height: number; }>) => void) => SizeObserver | null

exports.name: SizeObserver
exports.description: The part of ResizeObserver the canvas uses to watch node wrappers.

exports.name: withSystemClipboard
exports.description: Wraps `inner` (default: a memory clipboard) and best-effort writes JSON to `navigator.clipboard` on every copy.

exports.name: useFlow
exports.description: Fit view runs before nodes are measured on first paint; the canvas retries it once sizes arrive.

exports.name: useFlowView
exports.description: The view API of the enclosing `FlowCanvas`, for overlays such as the minimap, controls and panels; throws outside a canvas.

exports.name: FlowContext
exports.description: Lets overlays (minimap, controls, panels) inside a `FlowCanvas` reach its controller.

exports.name: FLOW_ZOOM_STEP
exports.description: Default step for the zoom buttons and keys, re-exported for hosts that build their own.

exports.name: UseFlowOptions
exports.description:
Graph, selection and viewport are each controlled (pass the value and its
`on…Change`) or uncontrolled (pass a default, or nothing). The change
callbacks fire in both modes, so a host can also just observe.

exports.name: FlowController
exports.description: The editor handle `useFlow` returns: the state, `dispatch`, and commands for connecting, editing, clipboard, history and the view.

exports.name: FlowViewApi
exports.description: The part of the controller that does not depend on the node data type; what the minimap and controls use.

exports.name: useFlowCanvas
exports.description: The canvas engine with no markup: pointer gestures (pan, drag, marquee, connect, pinch), wheel zoom, key bindings, node measuring and live announcements. The `Flow.*` parts draw from it.

exports.name: useFlowCanvasEngine
exports.description:
The enclosing canvas engine. `D` is the node data type of the `flow` given to
`Flow.Root`; a part names it to get typed nodes in its render props.

exports.name: FLOW_ACTIVATION
exports.description:
Click-vs-drag per pointer kind, on the dnd kit's activation rule and numbers,
so a node feels like a sortable row. Touch uses a distance (not the dnd kit's
long-press) because the pane is `touch-action: none`: a finger never scrolls
the page here, so there is nothing to tell a drag apart from.

exports.name: FLOW_KEY_CATEGORY
exports.description: Category the canvas commands show under in a keymap editor or cheatsheet.

exports.name: FLOW_UI_PROPS
exports.description:
Props for overlay chrome placed on the pane (panels, toolbars, minimaps, menus): the pointer
engine and wheel leave it alone (`data-flow-ui`), and the keyboard kit leaves its keys to its
own controls (`data-kb-owns="*"`), so a toolbar button still clicks on Space.

exports.name: provideEngine
exports.description: The context value for an engine of any node data type.

exports.name: FlowCanvasContext
exports.description: The engine of the enclosing `Flow.Root`, for the parts. Write it with `provideEngine`, read it with `useFlowCanvasEngine`.

exports.name: DRAG_MODES
exports.description: What dragging on empty canvas does: pan the view, or draw a selection marquee.

exports.name: DragMode
exports.description: One of `DRAG_MODES`.

exports.name: FlowCanvasOptions
exports.description: Behaviour options of a canvas; styling lives on the parts.

exports.name: FlowCanvasEngine
exports.description: What `useFlowCanvas` returns: the controller, gesture preview, focus, selection lookups and the props and refs the canvas parts spread.

exports.name: FlowPaneProps
exports.description: Props the pane element spreads; every event the engine needs arrives here.

props.name: ref
props.description: Attaches the pane element to the engine.

props.name: role
props.description: ARIA role of the pane.

props.name: aria-roledescription
props.description: Spoken role description of the pane.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the pane: the canvas `label`, else "Flow editor".

props.name: tabIndex
props.description: Makes the pane focusable so it receives key events.

props.name: data-flow-pane
props.description: Marks the element as the pane for the pointer engine.

props.name: data-dragging
props.description: Set while nodes are being dragged.

props.name: data-connecting
props.description: Set while a connection is being dragged.

props.name: data-read-only
props.description: Set when the canvas is read-only.

props.name: onPointerDown
props.description: Starts a pan, drag, marquee or connection, depending on what the press hit.

props.name: onPointerMove
props.description: Moves the gesture in progress.

props.name: onPointerUp
props.description: Ends the gesture in progress.

props.name: onPointerCancel
props.description: Cancels the gesture in progress.

props.name: onDoubleClick
props.description: Calls `onNodeDoubleClick` when the double-click landed on a node.

exports.name: FlowPreview
exports.description: What a gesture in progress draws: the marquee box, alignment guides, the connection being dragged.

exports.name: PortState
exports.description: A port's role in the connection being dragged; drives `data-*` attributes on the port.

props.name: source
props.description: The drag started here.

props.name: target
props.description: The drag is snapped to this port.

props.name: candidate
props.description: Would accept the dragged connection (true), would refuse it (false), or not in play (undefined).

exports.name: EdgeGeometry
exports.description: An edge's drawn path and its two end points, in flow coordinates.

exports.name: Flow
exports.description: The compound canvas: `<Flow.Root>` with the layer parts inside.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: The pane: owns pointer, wheel and key input, and provides the engine to every part inside it.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the pane element.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles merged over the pane's structural ones.

props.name: children
props.description: The layer parts and overlays.

props.name: flow
props.description: The controller from `useFlow` that holds the graph, selection and viewport.

props.name: snapGrid
props.description: Grid step dragged nodes snap to; 0 turns snapping off and alignment guides on.

props.name: guides
props.description: Alignment guides while dragging (only when not snapping to a grid).

props.name: dragMode
props.description: What dragging on empty canvas does; the other mode is on Shift. Middle button always pans.

props.name: wheel
props.description: What the plain wheel does; the other is on Ctrl/⌘ (a trackpad pinch arrives as Ctrl+wheel).

props.name: fitViewOnMount
props.description: Whether to fit the whole graph in view once the nodes are measured; until the user pans, zooms or edits, a pane resize refits.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: View only: pan, zoom, select and keyboard focus, but no moving, connecting or deleting.

props.name: onNodeDoubleClick
props.description: Called when a node is double-clicked, with that node.

props.name: onConnectAttempt
props.type: (reason: ConnectReason, from: PortRef, to: PortRef) => void
props.description: Every connection dropped on a port, with the rule's verdict (`ok` when the edge was made).

props.name: onConnectToEmpty
props.type: (from: PortRef, fromKind: PortKind, at: XY) => void
props.description: A connection dropped on empty canvas; `from` is where the drag began.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the canvas.

props.name: keyBindings
props.description: Key-map adapter: the bindings the canvas registers with the keyboard kit; `rebindFlowKeys` edits it.

props.name: messages
props.description: Wording of the live announcements; override any subset.

parts.name: Background
parts.description: The dot or line grid behind the graph, moving with pan and zoom.

props.name: variant
props.description: Grid pattern; `none` renders nothing.

props.name: gap
props.description: Pattern spacing in flow units; it scales and scrolls with the viewport.

props.name: color
props.description: Pattern colour: the `--flow-grid` CSS variable, then currentColor.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the background layer.

parts.name: Viewport
parts.description: The transformed layer: everything inside is in flow units.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the transformed layer.

props.name: children
props.description: The layers drawn in flow units: edges, nodes, guides and the rest.

parts.name: Edges
parts.description: Every edge as an SVG path; each `<g>` carries `data-flow-edge`, `data-selected` and `data-animated`.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the edges' SVG layer.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Classes per part: edge group, hit area, visible path and the two arrow markers.

props.name: pathClassName
props.description: Extra classes for one edge's visible path, from its data and state.

props.name: renderEdge
props.description: Draws what sits inside an edge's hit group; default: a wide transparent hit path and the visible path with an arrow.

props.name: hitWidth
props.description: Width of the invisible hit path, in flow units.

parts.name: ConnectionLine
parts.description: The connection being dragged from a port; `data-invalid` when its snapped target refuses it.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the default dashed path.

props.name: render
props.type: (props: { readonly d: string; readonly invalid: boolean }) => ReactNode
props.description: Draws the line yourself from its path `d` and whether its target refuses it.

parts.name: Guides
parts.description: Alignment guides while a node is dragged without a grid; one screen pixel wide at any zoom.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on each guide line.

parts.name: EdgeLabels
parts.description: Labels at each labelled edge's midpoint; clicking one selects the edge.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on each label element.

props.name: render
props.type: (props: { readonly edge: FlowEdge; readonly selected: boolean }) => ReactNode
props.description: Draws a label's content from its edge and whether it is selected; default the edge's `label` text.

parts.name: Nodes
parts.description:
Every node as a focusable wrapper (`data-flow-node`, `data-selected`, `data-focused`,
`data-locked`) with its body and port dots (`data-flow-port`, `data-port-kind`,
`data-port-side`, `data-source`, `data-target`, `data-candidate`).

props.name: render
props.description: Draws a node's body; ports are drawn around it. Default: the node's `data.label` (or id) as text.

props.name: classNames
props.description: Classes per part: every node wrapper and every port dot.

props.name: nodeClassName
props.description: Extra classes for one node wrapper.

props.name: portClassName
props.description: Extra classes for one port dot, e.g. a colour per `dataType`.

props.name: renderPort
props.description: Content inside a port dot (an icon, a count); the dot itself stays the hit target.

parts.name: Marquee
parts.description: The marquee box while selecting by drag.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the marquee box.

parts.name: Announcer
parts.description: The polite live region that reads out moves, connections, deletes and history.

props.name: className
props.description: Class on the live region; without one it is visually hidden.

exports.name: BACKGROUNDS
exports.description: Grid patterns the canvas background can draw.

exports.name: cx
exports.description: Joins class names, skipping empty ones (the parts stay free of any styling library).
exports.signature: (...parts: readonly (string | false | null | undefined)[]) => string | undefined

exports.name: nodeLabel
exports.description: Default body when no `render` is given.
